fusions.name: Bolting Leap
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 7 tiles to the target and deals 14 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at maximum range. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Hind Thump
fusions.desc: Kicks out in a ring, dealing 5 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Flat Out
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds and your dodge chance by 10%.

fusions.name: Already Gone
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
